topic: Alcohol withdrawal syndrome and delirium tremens management in ICU

mcqs.question: Who does CG100 say should be offered admission for medically assisted withdrawal?

options.A: People in acute withdrawal who have, or are at high risk of, seizures or delirium tremens
options.B: Every adult who drinks any alcohol
options.C: Only people already in the community on day 10
options.D: People with mild craving and no risk features, as a routine

mcqs.correctAnswerText: People in acute withdrawal who have, or are at high risk of, seizures or delirium tremens
mcqs.explanation: CG100 offers admission when there are, or there is high risk of, alcohol withdrawal seizures or delirium tremens.

sourceRefs.excerpt: offer admission to hospital for medically assisted alcohol withdrawal

mcqs.question: How does CG100 position the CIWA–Ar scale?

options.A: As a replacement for clinical judgement
options.B: As an adjunct to clinical judgement, within a local protocol
options.C: As a test only for liver transplant listing

mcqs.correctAnswerText: As an adjunct to clinical judgement, within a local protocol
mcqs.explanation: CG100 says follow a local protocol and consider CIWA–Ar as an adjunct to clinical judgement.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Consider using a tool (such as the Clinical Institute Withdrawal Assessment – Alcohol, revised [CIWA–Ar] scale ) as an adjunct to clinical judgement.

mcqs.question: Which regimen does CG100 say to follow for drug treatment of acute withdrawal in hospital?

options.C: No medication until delirium is established
options.D: Alcohol taper prescribed for home use only

mcqs.explanation: In hospital, or where 24-hour monitoring is available, CG100 says follow a symptom-triggered regimen.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Follow a symptom-triggered regimen for drug treatment for people in acute alcohol withdrawal who are: in hospital

mcqs.question: What is CG100 first-line drug treatment for delirium tremens?
mcqs.explanation: Offer oral lorazepam first. Parenteral lorazepam or haloperidol is for persistent symptoms or when oral medication is declined.

sourceRefs.excerpt: In people with delirium tremens, offer oral lorazepam as first-line treatment. If symptoms persist or oral medication is declined, offer parenteral lorazepam or haloperidol.

mcqs.question: What does CG100 say about phenytoin for alcohol withdrawal seizures?

options.C: Use it only with lorazepam in every case
options.E: Give a loading dose to all dependent drinkers

mcqs.explanation: CG100 says do not offer phenytoin to treat alcohol withdrawal seizures.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Do not offer phenytoin to treat alcohol withdrawal seizures.
